audience: agencies and service firms that run jobs, quotes and invoices in Streamtime

useCases.title: Find open jobs and unpaid invoices for a client
useCases.text: Search the jobs view for open work from one client. Read an invoice and its payments to see what is still unpaid.

useCases.title: Read a job with its phases, items and activity
useCases.text: Open a job for its status, dates and totals. Read its phases, its items and its activity feed.

useCases.title: Report totals by group for a date range
useCases.text: Read the report options of a view first. Then run the report to get totals, grouped as the view allows.

useCases.title: Check team roles and billable rates
useCases.text: List the users with their roles, branches and billable rates. Compare them with the rate cards that price time and items.

useCases.title: Post a comment to a job's activity feed
useCases.text: Read the activity feed of a job first. Then add a comment. The comment is visible to everyone with access to the job.

useCases.title: Change the status of a job
useCases.text: Read the job to find the status id you need. Then set the new status. The old status is overwritten.
